# generated by scripts/changelog.ts from the CHANGELOG.md files of the packages
version: 0.7.0
date: 2026-10-24
---

### Added

- Add `facts` in ginko.config: texts quote fields of single bricks with `:fact{name="practice.price"}`, and pages, site search, Markdown twins and llms-full.txt show the value in effect today (a planned change from its date). The Studio shows such a component as a chip with the value the page shows, and any inline component without text of its own as a chip instead of an empty box. Also `useGinkoFact()` and `valueOn()`. ([#46](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/46))
- Add a release check for facts: a release that removes a fact that texts still quote is refused and names those texts (`pnpm local:dev` shows a warning instead), and the pushed schema now includes `languages`, so the platform formats fact values the same way the site does. ([#46](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/46))
- Add `.mcp.json` from `pnpm local:dev`: an agent in the site folder works in the local CMS once you have signed in. ([#47](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/47))
- Add LocalBusiness subtypes (HealthAndBeautyBusiness, ProfessionalService, Store, Restaurant, TravelAgency and more) and Corporation, EducationalOrganization to `siteJsonLd` and `organizationLd`. ([#49](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/49))
- Add the config lines of the allowed way to each rejected schema change in `ginko check` and `ginko release`, with the site's brick and field names filled in. ([#53](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/53))
- Add `navTitle` (a short title for the navigation, breadcrumbs and previous/next links) and `navExtras: false` (no Tab, Badge, Icon) to docs pages; docs fields get German, English, Spanish and French labels in a "Navigation" group. ([#48](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/48))

### Changed

- Change the text of `legal()` to the `page` Markdown profile, so an imprint can quote the address and contact as facts. ([#49](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/49))

### Fixed

- Fix a release that changes components: it now checks every stored text that can use them, so a removed prop or option cannot break a page, and the plan lists the change. ([#51](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/51))
- Fix the Markdown twin printing icon names (`lucide:book-open`) from untranslated text fields as text. ([#48](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/48))
- Fix `checkSite` accepting a reference from a platform brick to a file brick; it now names the field and how to fix it. ([#49](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/49))
- Fix the docs theme defaults overriding a site's Tailwind 4 `@theme`: they now sit in `@layer theme`, so on a Tailwind site without its own fonts the docs use Tailwind's font stacks instead of Inter. ([#48](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/48))
